newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent led higher by strong U.S., technicals.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent led higher by strong U.S., technicals.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures gained further strength on Tuesday as U.S. numbers rose and broke through technical resistance levels, dealers said.
Oct IPE Brent was 21 cents a barrel up at $22.82 at 1552 GMT, after earlier bouncing off lows at $22.32. Sept gas oil was 50 cents higher at $217.75 a tonne.
"There is no real news as far as I can see," one IPE broker said. "We are following the strength in the U.S. and even dragging our heels a bit, as the artbitrage has widened."
He said Monday's high of $24.00 a barrel on the October NYMEX crude contract had been broken, and this was supportive.
Another dealer said hurricane activity in the U.S. had added a little support to numbers, but other brokers doubted this had much impact.
